name: DSG Governance Gate
description: DSG Governance Gate shows ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK decisions directly in Stripe payment detail views. The current transaction context is sent to the Cinema backend, which maps it to a bounded policy-decision QUBO and uses the server-side Z3 verifier to prove the global optimum. If the context or proof cannot be verified, the app falls back to REVIEW.
shortDescription: Exact Z3-verified policy decisions inside Stripe payment views

views.name: payment.detail
views.title: DSG Governance Gate
views.description: A familiar Stripe-native decision summary with exact Z3 proof status

content_security_policy.purpose: Send bounded Stripe transaction context to the Cinema verification backend. The app never sends a Z3 credential or accepts arbitrary solver programs.

features.title: Verified decision
features.description: See ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK with the reason and risk score at the top of the payment detail panel.

features.title: Exact Z3 proof
features.description: Cinema derives a fixed-size decision QUBO and accepts the result only when Z3 proves VERIFIED_GLOBAL_OPTIMUM.

features.title: Fail-closed review
features.description: Missing transaction context, backend errors, or unverified proofs are shown as REVIEW rather than approval.

permissions.name: External access
permissions.description: Send only the transaction fields required for deterministic policy verification to the Cinema backend.
